quote: LeanCTX is the open-source context engineering layer for AI agents. One local Rust binary that decides what they read, remembers what they learn, guards what they touch, and signs the proof.
60–90% fewer tokens per read; ~13 tokens per cached re-read.
Compression, caching, the savings ledger, and project memory all run locally on your machine; nothing is uploaded.
Cursor integrates via CLI-Redirect hybrid mode alongside MCP.
Compression — read-side and wire-side — is one of five subsystems, and every original stays locally retrievable.
PathJail: Every file access is canonicalised and confined to the workspace root.
An optional local proxy compresses every request to the model — system prompt, history and tool results — prompt-cache safe.
Free for local use, forever. Local use is free forever, enforced by CI.
Upgrade only when your team needs one shared context; Team plan uses per-seat pricing.
Install via script, Homebrew, npm, or cargo; run lean-ctx setup to auto-detect editors and wire hooks and MCP.
MCP config uses command lean-ctx with stdio transport; no args or env required.
Apache License 2.0
Hybrid mode: MCP for cached reads (~13 tokens) + shell hooks for command compression; MCP-only mode for protocol-only agents.
10 read modes from full content down to AST signatures; Adaptive ModePredictor learns optimal read mode per file type.
Context Mode operates at the MCP protocol layer — raw data stays in a sandboxed subprocess and never enters your context window.
Nothing leaves your machine. No telemetry, no cloud sync, no usage tracking, no account required.
Licensed under Elastic License 2.0 (source-available).
Hook-capable platforms include Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, OpenCode, and 17+ platforms via MCP + hooks.
ctx_search uses Porter-stemming and trigram FTS5 with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
PreCompact hook preserves tasks, files, and decisions across context compaction.
Context window optimization for AI coding agents via MCP + hooks across 17 platforms.
SB integrates context-mode as opt-in recommended tool for MCP result compaction and PreCompact state recovery.
Context Mode is ELv2 — not OSI-open; commercial bundling requires upstream license.
Cursor wiring merges MCP, hooks, and instruction fragment; Windows requires WSL.
Token compression tier 1c: RTK shell wiring; Context Mode MCP/fragment — complements Graphify and agentmemory.
SB recommends RTK and Context Mode as separate opt-in tools; agent must follow scaffolded hint for files > 5 KB.
Every saving lands in an Ed25519-signed, hash-chained ledger on your machine.
LeanCTX lists RTK (Rust Token Killer) as a compatible compression addon.
